title: #669 AC-9: the bundle receipt.json cannot agree with the HUD verdict as built
context: FR-20/AC-9 say the HUD verdict file, the HUD receipt and the bundle receipt.json carry the same verdict word at the end of a change. A real end-to-end test (real verify-backstop + runRepositoryVerification + writeHudReceipt, enterprise evidence_ledger on) shows they do not: HUD verdict and HUD receipt say 'Needs your attention' (stage-evidence and bundle-completeness failed), while receipt.json says PASSED. Cause: run-repository-verification.ts seals the bundle receipt from the gate-runner rows only (gateResultsToRows(results) + ratchet rows, ~line 481), BEFORE the stage-evidence gate, the checks gate and the late gates (bundle-completeness, visual-evidence, rules-loaded), and before verdictKindFor applies unrecorded-stage gaps. By #581 design the late rows are appended after the seal as unsealed rows. So a change failing only on those gates attests PASSED. The skip-turn staleness the issue reported is fixed by B4 (a skip leaves both HUD files untouched). Making receipt.json agree needs a code change not in the plan. The test is parked at the session scratchpad end-of-change-agreement.test.ts (fails today).
